pixel_coordinates: continuous; x right, y down; no crop
sign_quad_note: plate_quad encloses the rounded outer board; face_quad encloses the off-white text face. Inset text from rounded corners.
desk_led_quad_note: desk_led_quad is the seating-edge strip on paired work desks and the front-edge strip on other desks. desk_led_strips contains every rounded top-rim segment on paired desks, plus the boss's other three edges. Use only front-facing segments for overlays.
seat_anchor: upper cushion center; sprite feet attach here
visibility_note: in_frame/front_facing are geometric checks, not occlusion tests
compositing_note: night_base has screens and desk LEDs off. night_screens adds only screen light; night_leds adds only desk LED light. Fixed wall/rug/sign lighting stays on in all passes. Blend each pass relative to night_base. Paired monitors face their own outer seats: far-row backs face the camera, near-row screen faces are visible. Use screen_front_facing_camera with screen_quad, plus the screen spill region. LED quads cover the luminous strips; glow bounds are approximate, since bloom, indirect light and denoising can affect nearby pixels.

layout.seating: 2 facing rows x 4 columns; row 0 / indices 1-4 far, row 1 / indices 5-8 near, each left-to-right; joined desk fronts; all chairs face -Y

framing.desk_width_measurement: horizontal bounds of the rounded desktop outline
framing.desk_size_note: Sixteen desks across require narrower workstations in the unchanged room/camera. Desktop width is about 126.7 px at 2400 px output width; the earlier 160 px minimum cannot coexist with this 2 x 4 layout. Projected floor width 105.73%; floor + back-wall height 108.43%.
